async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the homepage by clicking the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link in the banner to avoid ambiguity
    await page.get_by_role('banner').get_by_role('link', name='Epoch & Drift Benchmark').click()
    # Wait for the homepage to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Locate the search bar using Accessibility Tree-centric selectors
    # Try common roles and names for search inputs
    search_bar = page.get_by_role('searchbox').or_(page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search')).or_(page.get_by_placeholder('Search')).or_(page.get_by_label('Search'))
    # Wait for the search bar to be visible with a timeout
    await search_bar.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)
    # Fill the search bar with 'diabetes'
    await search_bar.fill('diabetes')
    # Submit the search by pressing Enter
    await search_bar.press('Enter')
    # Wait for the search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Identify search results; assume they are links or articles
    # Use .all() to get a list and click the last one (bottom result)
    results = page.get_by_role('link').all()  # Adjust role if results are not links
    if not results:
        # If no links, try other roles like 'article' or 'listitem'
        results = page.get_by_role('article').all()
    if not results:
        results = page.get_by_role('listitem').all()
    if not results:
        raise Exception('No search results found')
    # Click the bottom result (last in the list)
    await results[-1].click()
    # Wait for the clicked page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
